hook.en: A factory that pollutes a river may still make a profit, but the town pays the price. Social responsibility asks business to consider everyone its decisions affect.

objectives.en: Explain the concept and need for social responsibility
Identify responsibilities towards different interest groups
Explain CSR under the Companies Act, 2013 and environmental responsibility

narration.en: A factory that pollutes a river may still make a profit, but the town pays the price. Social responsibility asks business to consider everyone its decisions affect.

body.en: Social responsibility is the obligation of business to make decisions and take actions that are desirable in terms of society's objectives and values, going beyond legal duties. Arguments for it: business uses society's resources and should give back; it has the power and the resources to solve problems; it creates a better environment in which to do business; it builds public image and long-run survival; and it can prevent government regulation by acting voluntarily. Arguments against include the cost, the lack of social skills in business, and the dilution of the profit objective.

title.en: On the board: responsibilities towards interest groups

text.en: Owners/shareholders: fair return, safety of investment
Workers: fair wages, safe conditions, respect
Consumers: quality, fair prices, honest information
Government: obey laws, pay taxes honestly
Applies to a company with net worth ≥ ₹500 crore, or
turnover ≥ ₹1,000 crore, or net profit ≥ ₹5 crore
Must spend 2% of average net profit of 3 years on CSR

body.en: Business causes pollution of air, water and land, and noise, through emissions, effluents, waste and noise from machines and traffic. It harms health, damages crops and buildings and reduces the quality of life. Business can reduce pollution by adopting cleaner technology, treating effluents, recycling waste, using energy efficiently, following pollution laws, training staff, and supporting environmental programmes. Many firms report on their sustainability performance.
